companyIntro.name: Sterling Cost & Contracts
companyIntro.mission: Control cost, time and contract risk on major construction projects.
companyIntro.culture: Every figure traces to a measurement or a rate. Notices are served on time, in writing.

projectBackground.name: Port Terminal Programme — Warehouse Package
projectBackground.context: The warehouse package is 40% complete but costs are running ahead. The PM needs a forecast, not a feeling.

manager.name: Helen Marsh
manager.note: Cost control is forecasting. Tell me where we'll end up and what I can still do about it.

assignment.title: Forecast the final cost
assignment.brief: Compute earned value, CPI, EAC, retention; build the package report in Excel and write the alert.

documents.name: Package Data
documents.note: Three packages with budget, spend and progress.

tasks.title: CPI
tasks.prompt: Earned value = 40% of £2,000,000 = £800,000; spent £900,000. What is CPI?
tasks.mistake: Dividing spend by earned value inverts it.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Estimate at Completion
tasks.reasoning: EAC projects final cost at current efficiency.
tasks.mistake: Adding only the overspend so far underestimates.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Retention
tasks.prompt: Interim certificate £400,000 with 5% retention. How much is retained (£)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Committed Cost
options: Money legally committed through orders and subcontracts, even if not yet spent
tasks.mistake: Reporting only spend hides future costs.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Package Cost Report (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Earned = B x D (column E); CPI = E / C (column F).
tasks.reasoning: MEP is the problem package at 0.8.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cost Alert
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence cost alert to the PM.
tasks.modelAnswer: Project CPI is 0.89, forecasting a final cost of £2.25M against a £2.0M budget, a £250,000 overrun. MEP is the main driver at CPI 0.80. I recommend a review of MEP productivity and variations, and a decision on contingency by Friday. We will re-forecast weekly until CPI recovers above 0.95.
tasks.reasoning: A good alert gives the forecast, the driver and the decision needed.
tasks.mistake: Alerts without a driver can't be acted on.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Surprise Overrun
caseStudy.background: A project reported 'on budget' until month 18, then revealed a £1.4M overrun. Commitments were not included in the forecasts.
